name: How quickly do I need to address a storm-related roof leak?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address a storm-related roof leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addressing a storm-related roof leak promptly is critical to prevent extensive secondary damage. Water can quickly lead to mold growth, rot, and structural issues if left untreated. Even small leaks can cause significant problems over time. We recommend contacting a restoration professional within 24-48 hours to minimize damage, mitigate further risks, and ensure a timely repair process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address storm-related roof leaks immediately to prevent secondary damage like mold and rot. Contact a professional within 24-48 hours.
